message.heliosphere.power_no_air: no atmosphere: a wind turbine needs air
message.heliosphere.power_sheltered: sheltered: put it up high with 2 blocks of open air around it
message.heliosphere.power_no_heat: no lava or magma within 4 blocks below
message.heliosphere.power_no_coolant: no coolant: the reactor needs water next to it
message.heliosphere.power_no_fuel: out of fuel: right-click with fuel to load it
message.heliosphere.power_battery_status: %s · stored %s FE (%s%%) · output up to %s FE/t
message.heliosphere.habitat_on: Field running: %s columns inside the ring, from %s blocks below the emitter to %s above: breathable air, 20°C, Earth gravity.
message.heliosphere.habitat_leak: The ring is not closed: there is a gap near %s, %s, %s (or it is larger than 40 blocks / 6400 columns). The wall at the emitter's height must go all the way round, doors shut.
item.heliosphere.bio_capsule.hint: Right-click a creature to take it in (health, name, age, collar and all), then right-click the ground to let it out. Players, bosses and machines cannot be taken.
item.heliosphere.bio_capsule.release: Right-click the ground to let it out
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_full: The capsule already holds a creature: let it out first
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_refused: That cannot be taken (no players, bosses or machines)
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_no_air: Careful: there is no breathable air here and Earth creatures slowly suffocate - let it out inside a habitat field.
